source.paraphrase: A collection schema is optional and recommended. When present, it is a Zod schema from astro/zod and validates every entry.

invariants.why: Without a schema, a missing or mistyped frontmatter field shows up later, at the template that reads it.
invariants.fixHint: Add schema: z.object({ ... }) and import z from "astro/zod". A schema may be a function, as in schema: ({ image }) => z.object({ ... }).
invariants.avoid: A spread object is not inspected, because the schema may arrive through the spread. A schema value that is not Zod is not distinguished from one that is. defineCollection outside src/content.config.* or src/content/config.* is not read.

source.paraphrase: Astro 5 build-time and live collections require a loader. The legacy type: "content" config does not supply one.

invariants.why: Astro cannot load the entries, so the collection is empty or the build fails.
invariants.fixHint: Pass loader: glob({ pattern, base }) or loader: file(...), or a live loader for defineLiveCollection.
invariants.avoid: A spread object is not inspected. The rule does not run when the nearest astro declaration can still install Astro 4, or when no astro declaration is readable. Astro 4 keeps type and schema in src/content/config.ts.
